authorityRole: This record captures the current accountable product correction and guides the next plan, process, acceptance contract and goal-mode projection. It is not permanent truth, does not authorize side effects or release, and must yield to later user correction or stronger evidence.
problemStatement: The current line proved a small portable collaboration contract, disciplined evidence boundaries and several bounded closure behaviors, but it still risks mistaking one plugin projection, one activation Hook and one single-arm dogfood loop for the intended product. The unresolved problem is larger: Accord must develop complete bounded self-bootstrapping capability across environment sensing, outcome and authority binding, capability reuse or acquisition, composition or authorship, execution, verification, learning, evolution, recovery and retirement. Product form must follow demonstrated outcome fit rather than constrain it, and a new accountable consensus may invalidate a ready baseline across every dependent surface.

northStar.mission: Make human-Agent collaboration reliably useful in real work while requiring the user to provide the goal, consequential judgment and unavoidable authority rather than managing Agent tools, configuration, context, topology, continuity or cleanup.
northStar.productPosture: agent-neutral, model-neutral, provider-neutral, host-adaptive, mechanism-neutral, product-form-neutral, open and independently governed
experience: latent availability after supported installation or enablement without forced per-message intervention
context-tailored activation and no-op when no residual benefit exists
environment-aware adaptation that distinguishes official-clean, already-extended, Accord-enabled, isolated and unknown baselines
complete bounded self-bootstrapping rather than self-evolution or plugin activation alone
Agent-owned discovery, routing, execution, correction, continuity, resource stewardship, verification and cleanup within granted authority
graceful degradation when a preferred capability or host surface is unavailable
northStar.success: Representative and longitudinal tasks show useful consequence-level outcomes with lower avoidable human burden, bounded interference and recoverable side effects across relevant environments; Accord can reuse, acquire, compose, verify, improve and retire its own means without confusing self-evolution with the complete bootstrap loop, letting environmental contamination or installed Accord logic validate itself, or promoting learning artifacts into authority.

retiredAsActivePremises.reason: Runtime, MCP, Hook, App, Skill, plugin, configuration, state and other carriers are possible implementation means. Their fitness depends on task, host, authority, lifecycle cost and observed interference.
A thin portable kernel can remain valuable, but it does not by itself deliver the intended low-burden end-to-end experience.

Subtraction targets duplication, stale assumptions, needless permanence and negative-value machinery; it must not silently discard an intended outcome without a sufficient native or replacement route or an explicit scope decision.
Host versions, model routes, providers and extension ecosystems are observed environment variables and compatibility evidence, not portable product identity.
Native capability, installed capability, official extensions, authoritative online sources, maintained third-party capability, composition and bounded authorship are all eligible discovery lanes.

A plugin is one useful projection and delivery vehicle, not YIYUAN Accord's identity or mandatory final shape. A Skill, Hook, runtime, local service, cloud service, client integration, protocol, library, an open-ended multi-form composition or no added mechanism may be fitter for a given closure. Sufficiency or insufficiency is proved responsibility by responsibility rather than presumed from form.

Mutation, experimentation and retained learning are one feedback component. Complete self-bootstrapping also requires environment and goal sensing, capability discovery and reuse, authority allocation, execution, consequence verification, rollback, continuity, resource release and retirement.

A baseline is a revision-bound statement of prior consensus and evidence. A later accountable correction may supersede it from the earliest affected dependency boundary while preserving it as immutable history.
File and size limits are revisable release checkpoints. Authority surfaces and representations may merge, split, move or retire through an explicit provenance-preserving migration and replay.
A route is computed from the current goal, environment, authority, evidence and cost. A prior sequence remains reusable experience only while its applicability conditions hold.
The preview.2 checkout remains an unreleased historical checkpoint, but its runtime-free product premise and release route were superseded by this correction before publication.

factorTaxonomy.meaning: desired human or product outcome and accountable value
small portable condition that remains unless explicitly changed at the product-governance boundary
falsifiable belief used to choose a design or route
directional idea for judgment, not an executable command
reusable way to analyze or solve a class of problems
minimum quality or interoperability threshold with a declared scope
context-bound decision rule including authority, risk, data, trust or cost
deterministic or probabilistic relation used to infer, rank or transition
means that creates, observes, controls, recovers or verifies an effect
revisable sequence selected for the current task or phase
contract or interface between roles, carriers, tools or systems
schema, prompt, index, graph, document or other projection of meaning
host, task, cloud environment, repository, branch, worktree, conversation or durable medium that carries work or state; a handoff is a transition between carriers
observable ability exposed natively, by extension, by composition or by bounded authorship
source-bound observation supporting a limited fact, effect or claim
measurement of outcome, burden, interference, cost, recovery or confidence
discovered, eligible, activated, healthy, degraded, superseded or retired state and transition

factorApplicabilityContract.defaultRule: Visibility or installation does not imply activation. Activation requires current applicability, authority and expected net value; deactivation does not require uninstalling a healthy latent capability.

adaptiveSystem.tailoringRule: Ideas, methodologies, standards, policies, rules, logic, mechanisms, processes, protocols, representations, carriers and metrics are scoped and activated by current facts. The observed environment must record its provenance and material deviations from an official-clean or explicitly isolated comparison baseline, including Accord's own installation and activation state. Only the few stable variables above are candidates for portable always-on treatment.

stageStateContract.changeRule: Each surface is a versioned, evidence-bound and rebuildable projection of the same current stage, not a permanent constant or freely editable preference. A change records its prior version, cause, evidence cutoff, affected criteria and earliest replay boundary; no projection may silently weaken acceptance, erase failed evidence or borrow authority from a future stage.
stageStateContract.closeoutSnapshotRule: When a stage closes, retain one current referenceable node projection that binds its stage identity, parent node, authority and surface locators, evidence, acceptance transition, evaluation contract, closed and next gates, finite claim ceiling, unknowns and invalidation triggers. The next gate is null only when the closed gate terminates the ordered release sequence. The current schema-v2 predicate does not admit a cross-version cycle from that terminal predecessor; any later-version cycle requires a separately reviewed schema or transition-contract successor. The node declares a containing-git-commit relationship and stable self locator but never stores its own SHA; after commit the exact external reference is <containing-sha>:<self-locator>. The canonical containing commit is the oldest commit in the contiguous first-parent run that carries the same node object; later identical carries do not create a node or rebind its frozen authority, surfaces, evidence or cutoff. A successor cites that prior exact locator, while Git preserves older nodes. Source mismatch invalidates the snapshot instead of letting it override authority, and the snapshot cannot self-attest release, field value or current host compatibility.
stageStateContract.historyRule: Persist only the latest accepted stage projection in current program state. Its predecessor locator must cite the canonical origin of the most recent different first-parent node. The current verifier recomputes only the bounded, schema-versioned repository snapshot-lineage predicate for every carry and recursively for that predecessor origin using one first-parent history index reused across the walk: strict node shape, origin-bound constitution, program and acceptance, referenced guidance and Golden Tasks, repository-located current and historical evidence bytes and digests, and declared host projection package, manifest, contract, Skill and marketplace identity. Each revision blob uses the admitted JSON byte limit; the history index has independent revision-count and aggregate-byte bounds. Complete normalized transition state, validated canonical goal derivations and exact raw bytes of every authority-declared derived surface plus marketplace determine affected criteria. Passing it does not replay the complete historical verifier or attest historical tests, behavior, live host facts, human authority, publication or other external gates. A malformed node, missing interval, carry locator, stale ancestor, excessive predecessor depth, resource-bound breach or non-contiguous replay fails closed instead of being skipped or washed into acceptance. Git history and the successor's exact predecessor locator preserve prior nodes; do not add a snapshot registry or duplicate whole authority surfaces.

evolutionHorizon.rule: The horizon is a sparse, on-demand derived view, not a second authority source, frozen roadmap, Cartesian precomputation or automatic commitment. Refresh only affected candidates when its inputs change; admit at most the next bounded increment through current goal, authority, feasibility, value, lifecycle and acceptance gates, while keeping every other item hypothetical, deferred, retired or unknown.
evolutionHorizon.storageRule: Do not persist unpromoted horizon items or maintain a horizon registry. Derive only task-relevant candidates in task state, discard them when invalidated and persist only the one candidate admitted as a versioned bounded increment.

capabilityDiscovery.coverageRule: YIYUAN Accord covers the Agent-neutral dynamic relation from requirement to capability, authority, route, observed effect and evidence; it does not take the capability surface of Codex, Claude or any other concrete Agent as the product boundary. A concrete Agent and its current host capability are replaceable adapters plus freshness-bound evidence snapshots, never the product ceiling.
primaryBenefits: model official and observed capability surfaces as source-bound, refreshable relations instead of fixed product assumptions
query sufficient existing native, model, extension, configured or composed routes before admitting an authored residual

effectiveCapabilityIdentity.semanticKey: stable capability meaning independent of provider, host or mechanism
effectiveCapabilityIdentity.rule: A semantic capability may have many effective instances. Availability, health, cost and fitness bind the observed combination, not a model, host, marketplace or installation label alone.

capabilityDiscovery.refreshRule: Refresh affected instances, sparse responsibility-incidence views and routes when their host, interface, extension, model route, configuration, permission, network, context or observation changes. New model-inherent, native or extended capability can open a responsibility-overlap candidate with Accord machinery; only admitted consequence and lifecycle closure proves actual redundancy. Removal can trigger degradation, discovery, composition or bounded authorship.
capabilityDiscovery.failureRule: Do not stop at today's host surface, a small marketplace or weak native feature when another compliant discovery or composition lane can satisfy the goal, but do not run discovery merely because a task exists. A public lead can open an inquiry or counterexample and cannot alone support a consequential adoption or product claim. Do not promise an unobserved capability, and do not browse, install, connect, spend or cross a trust or data boundary without the authority required for that effect.

boundedAutonomy.closureModel: Do not define YIYUAN Accord as a set difference. For the current outcome, derive the smallest relevant relation graph across obligations, capabilities, people, Agents, carriers, authority, evidence, resources, effects, state and lifecycle. Identify unclosed obligations, degraded or uncertain relations, coordination and verification risks, then select the feasible closure path with the lowest total burden. Recompute when any material node, relation or constraint changes.
boundedAutonomy.localGapView: A missing, degraded, uncertain, inaccessible or uneconomic capability may be represented as one local gap view, but it is neither the product definition nor a sufficient route decision. Native capability can still require alignment, composition, authority allocation, verification, continuity or lifecycle control; composition can create outcome capability not present as an independent set element. A host-native whole-loop improvement can make Accord action a no-op and retire overlapping machinery.

humanBoundary.rule: A technically host-reserved action is not automatically a human judgment. When the Agent cannot perform it, reduce it to one exact informed step, preserve veto, verify the observed effect and resume without transferring route knowledge or cleanup burden.

capabilityPlanes.rule: Derive semantic task capabilities from the current outcome. Reuse historical software, research, communication, learning, creative, operational and other capability nodes only when demanded; discover current sources when a node is absent or stale. Do not make YIYUAN Accord reimplement every domain capability or treat an inventory as exhaustive product scope.

boundedAutonomy.evaluationRule: A capability name, graph node, installation, implicit invocation, completed turn or passing static check is not finite-autonomy evidence. A representative task must observe the full collaboration closure from starting relations and constraints through chosen path, human burden, effect, correction, verification, release and cleanup, including correct no-op and failure paths.

selfBootstrappingCore.definition: The bounded ability to establish and improve the minimum sufficient means needed to close the current collaboration outcome from live conditions while preserving human authority, evidence honesty, reversibility and lifecycle control. It is a recursive product capability, not a promise of unrestricted autonomy or self-authorizing self-modification.

semanticModel.authorityRule: The latest bound goal, accountable consensus and human-owned boundaries authorize the model. Environment observations, indexes, routes, scores, experiments and carriers may challenge or derive from authority but never create it.

responsibilityAllocation.rule: Allocate each responsibility independently; one route may mix all three modes. Forms, source kinds and whole-task labels cannot substitute for this allocation. Accord-contained means Accord closes the duty through an admitted internalized mechanism; Agent-native means current observed Agent or host behavior closes it and Accord remains no-op except for bounded observation and verification; Accord-Agent-composed means named duties are divided across Accord and Agent under one authority, interface, state, failure, evidence, cleanup and retirement contract.
responsibilityAllocation.stageRule: Observation, injection, execution, consequence, independent evidence and field value are distinct stages. An observed Hook or context injection may enable a route but cannot self-attest Agent use, effect, completion or Accord value.

dimensions.definition: Observe the composed system's current state, capabilities, boundaries, dependencies, risks and unknowns, including Accord's own exposure.
Keep purpose, outcome, authority, rules, structure, route, action, evidence, acceptance, claims and results logically reconciled.
Within a bound outcome and granted authority, allocate responsibilities, select routes, orchestrate supported work and maintain order.
Use admitted facts, feedback, experience, failure and environment change to update evidence, fitness and regression obligations or form or acquire a candidate capability for governed validation.
Detect contradiction, drift or error, locate the earliest affected boundary, correct it, replay dependents and preserve regression evidence.
After reversible failure, conflict or local damage, roll back, degrade, replace, hand off or restore the last safe state and continuity, or stop honestly when recovery is unavailable.
Produce source-bound records of judgment, action, process, consequence and post-state that an independent evaluator can verify without letting the system attest its own correctness.

Over time propose bounded changes, upgrade replaceable capability, test the full acceptance vector, retain only net improvements, roll back failures and expand verified applicability or compound value only when longitudinal evidence supports it.

hostLeveragedBootstrap.allocationRule: For a complete bounded self-bootstrapping claim, all eight dimensions are responsibility families. Decompose only their material current duties and allocate each to accord-contained, Agent-native or Accord-Agent-composed execution; each duty must be closed, explicitly retired or held unknown with an honest stop. Do not build eight modules or a Cartesian capability matrix.
hostLeveragedBootstrap.upstreamRule: The upstream AI Agent, host-native capabilities and ecosystem are the primary candidate means. Accord drives their selection, coordination, constraint, verification, correction and retirement, and authors only the smallest replaceable Accord-contained gap after an evidenced failure of sufficient native or reusable routes.
hostLeveragedBootstrap.evidenceRule: This lens is not eight built-in abilities and is not behavior or value evidence. External verifiability means self-prepared, source-bound evidence that remains independently checkable rather than self-attested proof. Mapping these responsibilities does not expand the v3.1 public claim ceiling.
hostLeveragedBootstrap.independenceLimit: Accord does not claim host-independent operation. Hidden state, human values, new human authority, unavailable upstream capability, real-world value and arbitrary irreversible effects remain external constraints, unknowns or honest-stop conditions.

stateCoordination.axisRule: State coordination is orthogonal to responsibility implementation. A responsibility may be Accord-contained, Agent-native or composed while its required fields remain host-owned observed facts, Accord-owned exposed facts or field-scoped interoperable facts.
stateCoordination.carrierRule: Prefer a healthy official native carrier when it fits the contract. Do not default to raw conversations, credentials, unrelated host state, a new service, Runtime or durable store; sharing a field is not evidence that an Agent used it or produced the claimed consequence.
stateCoordination.subtractionRule: When a current official carrier independently closes the same state acquisition, storage, synchronization, invalidation or other responsibility with lower total burden, retire the displaced Accord Runtime, adapter or third-party wheel under the ordinary reversible same-duty retirement gate; do not keep two permanent paths merely because both exist.

entities.meaning: A result condition with an owner, completion criterion, consequence and residual-risk boundary.
A duty to perform, coordinate or verify a bounded part of one outcome obligation.
A person, Agent or accountable external participant that can own responsibility, authority or action.
A stable semantic ability that may support one or more responsibilities.
A freshness-bound observation of capability fitness under an exact composed environment.
A replaceable delivery shape that carries capabilities, state or effects without becoming product identity.
The shared responsibility, interface, authority, state, evidence, version, failure, recovery and retirement contract for cooperating forms.
An observed host, task, repository, client, cloud or durable medium that transports work or state.
An attributable unit of context, execution, connection, storage or capacity with ownership and lifecycle.
An observed material change that may satisfy or violate an outcome obligation.
Source-bound support for one limited observation, effect, criterion or claim.
A fixed-budget, reversible proposal to change one bounded route, policy, representation or replaceable mechanism.

relationKinds.meaning: An obligation, responsibility or route needs another relation to be viable.
A responsibility, authority, resource or effect has an accountable owner.
A capability instance is exposed by an actor, form or composition.
A capability instance or route is fit only under a bound composed context.
A current responsibility is assigned in one explicit Accord-contained, Agent-native or Accord-Agent-composed mode and may use no added artifact, one form or several forms.
Two replaceable forms jointly discharge named responsibilities.
A route or cooperating form set follows one coherence, authority or evaluation contract.
Current work or state is bound to an observed carrier.
A route uses an attributable resource or budget.
An observed effect supports a named outcome obligation within a finite claim.
An effect, post-state or cleanup claim is supported by independent evidence.
A view, route or decision is recomputable from named sources and observations.
A correction, conflict, expiry or failed invariant defeats a dependent relation or claim.
A route narrows to a less capable but still honest disposition.
A form, carrier or mechanism has an admitted substitution path.
A responsibility allocation or mechanism has an explicit composition-bound expiry, admitted successor, reversible transition, independent retirement post-state and recheck condition.

factModel.rule: Facets are independent facts connected by explicit causal relations, not a linear enum. A later observation never backfills an earlier facet; missing causality remains visible.

formAllocation.rule: System coherence comes from the shared contract and observed relations. It is not inferred from co-installation, a common vendor, one process, one repository or one centralized runtime.

evolutionTransaction.rule: A proxy gain cannot compensate for weakened authority, evidence, burden, interference, recovery or lifecycle fitness.

continuityDecision.rule: Static instructions are not current state. A carrier transports accountable state but never becomes its authority; newer bound consensus refreshes or supersedes stale derived state. Forking and handoff remain distinct topology operations even when both create another carrier.

invariants.rule: No observation, capability, route, score, experiment, carrier or product form grants new human-owned authority.
Unknown, unobserved, infeasible, contaminated and failed remain distinct from closed.
Declaration, installation, enablement, activation or execution never substitutes for the claimed consequence and post-state.

Every admitted responsibility has an owner, one explicit Accord-contained, Agent-native or Accord-Agent-composed allocation or no-op reason, a verifier and a lifecycle disposition; one route may mix modes.

Cooperating forms cannot rely on implicit shared state, authority, ordering, recovery or cleanup; every interoperable field has one authoritative writer, bounded readers and conflict or invalidation semantics.
Indexes, graphs, snapshots and routes retain source, provenance, freshness and invalidation and are never a second authority source.
Capability and route fitness bind the exact composed environment and Accord exposure; self-observation cannot attest a clean baseline.
The candidate cannot alter its authority, evaluator, baseline, tolerance or independent post-state requirement.
Cross-session state has currentness, ownership, recovery, migration, deletion and retirement or the continuity claim narrows.
Only task-exclusive attributable exposure is released automatically; shared or unknown ownership is preserved.
A material consensus or fact change replays every dependent surface from the earliest affected boundary while preserving unrelated truth.

Flexibility cannot justify unused, duplicated, stale or non-retirable forms and mechanisms. Retirement is responsibility-scoped and composition-bound: an admitted successor must independently close the same consequence and cleanup before a reversible observed transition, and local coverage cannot self-attest whole-product retirement.

semanticModel.projectionRule: The dynamic index derives only queried entity instances, responsibility allocations and relations from current authority plus observations. It must invalidate affected projections on material change and never precompute a host-model-tool-context-form Cartesian product.

environmentAdmissionContract.purpose: Decide whether an environment observation may support one named claim, whether a comparison arm is required, and which minimum isolation or honest degradation is proportionate to material confounding. It does not certify a host as globally clean.

snapshot.compositionKeyRule: Derive a stable key only from normalized non-secret identifiers and explicit unknown markers. The key locates one observed composition; it is not proof that hidden state is absent or that two environments are equivalent.
snapshot.freshnessRule: Freshness is scoped to the claim and every material composition member. Expiry or a changed member invalidates only dependent capability, route, comparison and claim projections.

liveObservationReceipt.admissionRule: At Accord entry and each material decision, effect, verification, cleanup or handoff boundary, a decision-relevant environment carries a current typed receipt. Resolve each field from a supported official structured API first, then other current official host-owned state, Accord-owned state or bounded direct observation when needed; bind its normalized decision target and value, one writer, bounded readers, provenance, current generation, freshness and validity, and require a fallback to enumerate unavailable higher-priority sources. Lifecycle events and material change only invalidate. Missing, conflicting, unbound, signal-only, future, expired, invalidated or mismatched fields hold unknown until re-sensing issues a new receipt.
liveObservationReceipt.adapterRule: Use each host's current native context and authorized read-only discovery at task time. Event-capable adapters may issue low-cost invalidation hints; hosts without such events re-probe just in time at the same material boundaries. Do not add a watcher, Runtime or durable state solely to emulate events.
liveObservationReceipt.projectionRule: The receipt keys only dependent ephemeral graph instances, sparse H, A and S views, admission masks, routes, retirement allocations and claims. A new generation invalidates and recomputes those dependents without rebuilding an exhaustive environment matrix or rewriting unaffected authority.
liveObservationReceipt.privacyAndLifecycle: Read only permitted non-secret metadata and task-owned state. Never read credential or conversation content, derive secret fingerprints, persist a live host inventory, start silent continuous telemetry or background work, or treat receipt validation as source authenticity, behavior, value or Hook-causality proof.

armKinds.meaning: A provenance-bound official distribution or host profile with directly observed absence of non-official material deviations and Accord within the declared scope.
armKinds.claimLimit: Official provenance and scoped observations do not prove absence of hidden account, network, firmware, service-side or prior-state differences.

armKinds.meaning: A fresh disposable task-owned environment containing only the declared minimum surfaces required for the bounded probe.
armKinds.claimLimit: Minimal does not mean official-clean, production-equivalent or representative of the user's composed host.

armKinds.meaning: The actual current composed environment, including observed Accord and other extension exposure plus explicit unknowns.
armKinds.claimLimit: It can support scoped current-composition behavior but cannot self-attest a native, no-Accord or clean baseline.

armKinds.meaning: A disposable comparison composition in which Accord exposure is directly observed absent while other material dimensions are matched, bounded or declared different.
armKinds.claimLimit: It is a no-Accord control only for matched dimensions and is not automatically an official-native baseline.

armKinds.meaning: A disposable arm derived from an admitted comparison base with one exact candidate identity and its declared treatment exposure added.
armKinds.claimLimit: It supports a causal comparison only when the evaluator is independent and all other material differences are matched or explicitly handled.

confounding.rule: Classify materiality against the named claim, not by the mere presence of an extension or difference. Absence of an observed confounder means none observed within scope, never globally uncontaminated.

isolationLadder.boundary: No added isolation; bind the claim to the observed current composition.
isolationLadder.useWhen: The claim is non-causal and composition-specific, no material confounder affects it, and direct independent effect evidence is available.

isolationLadder.boundary: Use task-owned synthetic inputs or an in-memory fixture with no live-host mutation.
isolationLadder.useWhen: The question is semantic, algorithmic or fail-closed logic and field equivalence is not claimed.

isolationLadder.boundary: Use fresh task-owned configuration, state, workspace and process roots with explicit inherited surfaces.
isolationLadder.useWhen: Local extension, configuration, state, workspace or process contamination could change the decision.

isolationLadder.boundary: Use a disposable container, VM, user profile, device or condition-fit remote host with declared kernel, account, network and service inheritance.
isolationLadder.useWhen: Process-level isolation is insufficient and the consequence, comparison or compatibility claim justifies the cost.

isolationLadder.boundary: Use a separately controlled evaluator or real condition-fit environment outside the candidate's authority.
isolationLadder.useWhen: A causal, consequential, cross-host, field-value or release-bearing claim requires independence that lower levels cannot provide.

environmentAdmissionContract.isolationSelectionRule: Choose the least costly available boundary that either removes each material confounder, holds it constant, measures it independently or narrows the claim so it is no longer material. Isolation may reduce confounding but never creates missing authority, professional judgment, effect observability or rollback.

rules.when: The claim concerns only the observed current composition and does not infer a native or causal baseline.
The claim uses native, clean, unmodified or no-Accord language.
rules.then: require an independently observed official-clean, isolated-minimal or isolated-no-Accord arm whose narrower meaning is stated

rules.when: The claim attributes a consequence, burden or interference difference to Accord or a candidate.
rules.then: require matched isolated-no-Accord and candidate-enabled-isolated arms plus an independent evaluator

rules.when: A material composition member or confounder is unknown.
No authorized affordable boundary can remove, hold, measure or bound a material confounder.
The effect is irreversible or requires new human-owned authority.

comparisonContract.counterfactualRule: Create only arms needed to answer the named decision. A current-composition observation needs no automatic clean arm; an incremental-effect claim needs a comparison that differs only by the declared treatment or makes every other material difference explicit.
comparisonContract.claimRule: Report per-arm composition, unknowns and effects before any difference. Causal language is allowed only for an admitted matched comparison; otherwise report association or scoped behavior.

cleanupAndInvalidation.rule: Release only task-exclusive attributable isolation resources. A cleanup command, task completion or disappearance from one listing is not post-state evidence.

environmentAdmissionContract.projectionRule: Persist durable vocabulary and decision rules only. Keep real environment snapshots, composition keys, permitted observations and arm allocations ephemeral or in evidence artifacts with scope, provenance, freshness, privacy, invalidation and cleanup; never commit a live host or account inventory as authority.

feasibilityGate.rule: Research is a context-bound evidence-acquisition responsibility, not a mandatory first step or permanent subsystem. Derive it only when a missing, stale or conflicting fact, unresolved reuse candidate, material novelty, consequence risk or architecture premise could change the current route; a sufficiently evidenced route produces no research intervention. When active, recover relevant counterevidence, prefer current primary sources and suitable maintained wheels, treat public-lead sources only as inquiry or counterexample inputs, and stop or hold unknown before architecture commitment or implementation when the material premise remains unresolved. P4 admits only the deterministic pure-data reference core described by productFormPrototypeDecision; every live Adapter, network effect, mechanism and behavior claim remains independently gated.

productFormPrototypeDecision.question: Can one responsibility-and-evidence-driven selector derive current admission conditions from the outcome, human authority, compliance, claim and observed environment; compare no added mechanism, the current plugin projection, a replaceable composition and bounded authorship under that same closure and lifecycle contract; choose the minimum feasible route without a fixed product-form or policy catalogue; reject a proxy improvement that worsens the full vector; and fail closed on residue?
productFormPrototypeDecision.representativeObligation: Preserve one exact corrected delivery brief across a bounded carrier interruption, execute the outcome, independently observe its consequence and release every task-owned continuity resource.
productFormPrototypeDecision.boundedEvolutionResult: A persistent authored controller that could improve one proxy was lifecycle-dominated by the minimum composition and was discarded and rolled back.
productFormPrototypeDecision.graphProjectionImpact: Persist only the route decision vocabulary and provenance. Derive responsibility-to-form allocations, route instances, capability fitness, effects, experiments, resources and lifecycle edges for the current query and composition; expire them on invalidation instead of materializing a host-by-model-by-tool-by-context-by-form product.

referenceCoreImplementation.moduleDepth: One pure interface hides structural validation, stable compliance invariants, dynamic policy admission, per-responsibility Accord-contained, Agent-native or Accord-Agent-composed allocation, task-policy inclusion or omission of a context-bound evidence-acquisition responsibility, responsibility closure, sparse capability-overlap inputs, unknown preservation, Pareto frontier derivation, contextual or equivalent-fit selection, experiment keep-discard-rollback decisions, source-observer-exact-subject-boundary identity binding, successor discovery and retirement evidence binding, independent consequence and cleanup post-state, matching lifecycle post-state, residue and finite claim handling. Graphs, source catalogues and matrix views remain implementation choices behind normalized plain-data routes rather than enlarging this interface.

selfBootstrappingCore.selfEvolutionRole: Self-evolution proposes and evaluates bounded changes to hypotheses, routing fitness, prompts, policies, representations or replaceable mechanisms. It never substitutes for environment sensing, goal and authority binding, capability acquisition, execution, verification, rollback or retirement, and it cannot optimize a proxy beyond the bound outcome and claim.
selfBootstrappingCore.environmentRule: Treat every real host as a composed environment rather than an official blank slate. At Accord entry and material boundaries, prefer current typed official host-owned fields, then Accord-owned fields and bounded direct observation; the normalized decision target and value, one writer, bounded readers, source precedence, provenance, current generation and freshness bind every admitted field. Events only invalidate. Missing, conflicting, unbound, signal-only, stale, expired, invalidated or mismatched state remains unknown until re-sensed. Detect extensions, Accord exposure, persistent state, self-observation and unknowns; select only decision-needed isolation. An Accord-enabled arm cannot attest a native or no-Accord baseline, and isolation cannot create authority or universal cleanliness.
selfBootstrappingCore.evaluationRule: Select representative cases by outcome-obligation and failure-mode coverage rather than convenience or prior success. Keep one-episode representative evidence distinct from an ordered longitudinal sequence; derive comparison eligibility from the named counterfactual; bind exact environment, projection, treatment, evaluator, carrier, effects and cleanup; and retain all attempts. Judge outcome, authority, evidence, privacy, burden, interference, recovery, resources, continuity and lifecycle as a non-compensating vector. A longitudinal evolution claim requires baseline, rejection and rollback of a regressed mutation, independent acceptance of one net improvement and later invalidation with rollback, replacement or retirement. Design, static checks and a single sequence are not field or population value.
selfBootstrappingCore.reuseRule: When authorship or architecture commitment remains a current candidate and existing admitted evidence cannot establish sufficient fit, dynamically search for and understand suitable existing wheels before authorship. When fresh evidence already closes the route, create no research responsibility. Record provenance, freshness, license, maintenance health, exact reusable idea or component, fit, limits, counterevidence, side effects, integration burden, rollback and retirement. Public-lead channels may discover a candidate or counterexample but cannot alone establish consequential fit; re-observe the underlying primary, official, repository or scholarly source. Adopt a pattern without inheriting its personality, prestige, platform assumptions or metric as authority.
selfBootstrappingCore.productFormRule: Allocate each currently relevant responsibility to plugin, Skill, Hook, protocol, library, runtime, service, client integration, cloud carrier, an open-ended composition or no added artifact only after the required effect, environment, authority, latency, isolation, durability, update, recovery and lifecycle properties are known. Treat every retained capability as a replaceable module with one narrow interface and high internal depth: responsibility, authority, state, evidence and lifecycle stay cohesive while host-specific variation sits in adapters at real seams. Add a seam only when at least two justified adapters vary there; keep graph, matrix, cache and evaluator internals behind the module interface. One form may be sufficient and several replaceable modules may cooperate; shared outcome, authority, evidence and lifecycle contracts provide system coherence without requiring one centralized carrier. User experience follows plug-and-play and remove-and-leave: after unavoidable source trust, prefer one host-supported lifecycle intent that bundles or dependency-composes all selected Accord components, uses plugin-scoped or namespaced surfaces instead of replacing AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, config.toml or settings.json, preserves or restores the last verified active state and completes only safe attributable bounded compensation before returning, preserves concurrent edits plus shared and foreign state, and removes only Accord-owned state. Unknown ownership or unsafe compensation is an adapter gap and cannot be reported as success or transferred to the user as internal repair. This does not imply host-automatic, in-place or crash atomicity. Manual user component assembly cannot be counted as success. Form is a dynamic route variable and may change across contexts, but flexibility itself must remain observable, bounded and verifiable.
selfBootstrappingCore.consensusRule: Record a new accountable consensus as a versioned correction and let it govern direction, while distinguishing judgment from factual proof. Before downstream execution, compare it with the current proposition set for contradiction, category error, boundary drift and dependency impact; repair from the earliest affected dependency or stop the affected route. Preserve the superseded baseline as history, then replay the plan, process, acceptance, goal projection, implementation, evidence, documentation and claim surfaces that depend on it. Only the reconciled set becomes the next coherent implementation baseline.

topology.independenceRule: Code topology, conversation topology and execution or resource placement are orthogonal. A compact, causal fork or sequential handoff does not create or select a checkout, branch, worktree or repository fork; a code-topology change does not prove state transfer or conversation continuity; and local or cloud placement changes neither unless separately bound. Bind and verify each only when the outcome requires it.
topology.hostVocabularyRule: Treat project, workspace, task, thread, conversation, session and similar host labels as adapter vocabulary. Localized labels and reused icons may collide across topology planes, so require object, operation and inheritance semantics before selecting a capability. Normalize them into canonical code-carrier, outcome-task, conversation-carrier and execution-instance relations with provenance; similar names or broad functions open equivalence evaluation but do not prove identical inheritance, authority, effects or lifecycle.
topology.continuityRiskRule: Capacity pressure, summarization and handoff are observed examples, not a closed taxonomy. Reconcile from the earliest affected boundary whenever any source-bound condition can lose, distort, stale or misbind goal, state, authority, evidence, resources, topology, time or causality.
topology.rule: The Agent selects and verifies topology from host-native signals and current constraints. Compact means same-carrier memory reduction; causal conversation fork means copied-history conversation branching; sequential context relief means a fresh zero-inherited-history conversation carrier, minimum verified state transfer, destination verification and only then source release. A Git branch is a ref and a Git worktree is a checkout. These are not interchangeable. The user is asked only when a new authority, trust, data, cost, destructive, irreversible or publication boundary makes the choice genuinely human-owned.
topology.codexCloud: Codex Cloud is a first-class execution, comparison, verification and continuity carrier when its isolated environment, setup, secrets, network policy and source revision fit the task; it is not merely a release checker and does not inherit unverified local state.

resourceStewardship.scope: Observe and dynamically steward context, turns, conversations, workers, terminals, connections, subscriptions, child processes, task artifacts and host capacity without making any concrete host primitive or controller part of portable identity.
resourceStewardship.nativeFirstRule: Reuse sufficient healthy host-native limits, interruption, cleanup and reclamation. Exposed controls or performance traces prove available primitives or diagnostics, not automatic whole-loop governance; when the host demonstrably closes the loop, Accord-specific action is a passing no-op and retirement candidate.
resourceStewardship.automationRule: Act automatically only on attributable task-exclusive resources through authorized, reversible, bounded and verifiable actuators. Shared or unknown ownership forbids destructive reclaim; lower admission or concurrency, choose a lighter route, preserve the resource and surface the unknown instead.
resourceStewardship.privacyRule: Performance tracing is an on-demand diagnostic input. Do not require continuous tracing, silently collect or upload traces, or claim optimization or release from trace existence alone.
resourceStewardship.implementationGate: Do not author a scheduler, daemon, Hook, MCP or runtime merely because native controls are incomplete. First inventory and consume all relevant supported official query, action, event, capability, state, topology, permission and lifecycle surfaces; demonstrate the residual unclosed outcome obligation or relation that those routes cannot close at lower total burden; then choose the smallest replaceable mechanism with isolation, health, rollback, cleanup and retirement evidence.

dynamicIndex.sourceRule: Store durable semantic facts, decisions and provenance; read current host facts directly from supported official structured surfaces when available; do not manually duplicate every derived edge, recreate a second authoritative host capability database or commit transient host state.

dynamicIndex.routeQuery: Find current responsibility-to-form paths and required state-field bindings that close the outcome across requirements, capabilities, actors, forms, carriers, contracts, evidence, resources and effects. dynamicIndex.learningBoundary: Observed task data may update health, fitness, confidence, regression and retirement inputs. It does not automatically change product authority, install capability, publish, or authorize a consequential effect.

researchAndExperienceInputs.rule: Treat the pre-Accord system as the provenance of the Agent execution and host-adaptation subdomain, not as the whole product or a discarded predecessor. Recover concepts and failures by exact revision; do not roll back the tree or restore retired validator generations wholesale.
Use current evidence and representative tasks; do not turn a report into product truth.
Recover and define its exact axes before encoding or testing it; the name alone is not sufficient authority.
Re-resolve current primary sources and source or repository behavior before adapting; OpenAI is neither portable authority nor product identity.
Adopt only goal-relevant evidence-backed ideas after neutral comparison; Anthropic is neither portable authority nor product identity.

Study primary repositories and first-party explanations for small legible implementations, one-variable experiment surfaces, fixed budgets, keep-or-discard loops, reviewable diffs and educational decomposition. Record the exact transferable pattern, license, scope, platform and metric assumptions, missing authority and lifecycle controls, Goodhart and contamination risks, and the Accord-specific exit condition. Reputation, stars and simplicity are not evidence of fit; autoresearch-style self-evolution is one bounded experiment operator inside the larger self-bootstrapping core.

selectiveCapabilityRecall.rule: The new plan supplements and corrects the pre-Accord Agent execution system inside Accord. Recover a historical capability when a current representative problem re-establishes its outcome value, then reshape it through official capability discovery, dynamic applicability, native delegation, hot update, verification and retirement. Recover the smallest semantic contract, failure standard or reusable mechanism that closes the evidenced gap; do not restore the historical architecture, controller, workflow, file set or implementation generation wholesale.
selectiveCapabilityRecall.firstSlice: Resource stewardship is the first corrected Agent-execution-subdomain slice: it recalls the historical attribution and release boundary as L8 and GT-12, adds current official capability discovery and dynamic native-first routing, and leaves the old preflight, generic Skills and unproven controller design in history. Process-loss control is not a new adjacent feature but a recalled original pre-Accord Agent-execution mission: current GT-07 and GT-11 must preserve the latest demand and corrections through goal, authority, route, implementation, evidence, acceptance and final claim without requiring a real carrier transition when the live carrier is healthy. Runtime machinery remains evidence-gated.

wholeSystemBalanceReview.purpose: Expose coupled weak links and tradeoffs before candidate formation, then drive minimum justified remediation and affected-surface reacceptance without turning a checklist or average score into product truth.
wholeSystemBalanceReview.baselineRule: There is no single timeless baseline. Bind each comparison to its claim and dimension: the immutable public v3.0.1 release may baseline published distribution and bounded public behavior; historical unreleased exact checkpoints may baseline only their retained implementation or regression facts; the moving main snapshot may baseline only the current audit cut; and behavior or incremental-effect claims require their declared controlled counterfactual arms. Every baseline records exact revision or environment, provenance, evidence level, known confounders, claim limit, freshness and invalidation triggers. An Accord-enabled composed host cannot self-attest an official-clean or no-Accord baseline.
wholeSystemBalanceReview.decisionRule: No comparison begins before its baseline, target and counterfactual are compatible with the claim. No aggregate score can compensate for a violated authority, evidence, consequence, cleanup or release hard gate. Among otherwise admissible routes, prioritize the weakest outcome-relevant link and Pareto improvements over cosmetic breadth; account for improvement, regression, coupling, reversibility, blast radius, user burden and lifecycle cost. An unknown that can change the release decision remains unresolved. Self-review supplies a candidate for independent challenge and never counts as independent evidence.
